reviews.x: I ordered the perfume Sex in the City Love. I received a perfume labeled Sex in the City Love 2. I'm wondering if the 2 meant it was a knock off. I sprayed the perfume and it smelled good for about 10 minutes and then the smell went away. I tried it several times and actually over sprayed myself yet again the smell immediately went away and I nor anyone else could smell it. The only positive was that I received my order quickly.  I buy a lot from Amazon for seversl years now and this purchase is

I like it. It was mainly what I wanted and it was okay. The bad thing was the costly delivery charges for this SINGLE item :(" The item had a pricing of $1.33 and the shipping charges was $8.55. Like.... what the hell!! What kind of item had such a heavy shipping charges attached? I feel cheated and ripped of with this fee/charge. Guess it was too good to be true. I regret making this purchase. I should have read the negative reviews prior to adding this crap to my cart!!

I absolutely love this perfume. It's very soft but not strong smelling either. It lasts all day. At max about two sprays in the areas that you need it. It's soft like the Juicy Couture that I own. This is authenic and came brand new in the box WITH the plastic over it too. It came sooner than what I expected it to come in the mail. The size of the perfume is just overwhelming too. I will definitely buy more when the time comes.

The smell is sweet then softens throughout the day. Bad thing though, if too much is sprayed on the clothes, the smell still lightly lingers on your clothes even after being washed/dry cleaned. >>> FYI not safe on silk. But if you don't mind the linger, then I say go for it. Its attracting to guys and its not over powering to your nose.

I didn't know I was going to get lotion alongside the perfume. This is for my mom for Christmas so I really hope she likes it!  It scared me to read some of the past reviews the day before it was to be delivered to my door but I got something that says "Sex and the City 2 Love Perfume and Lotion" so it's not an impostor brand. :P

I personally collect perfume bottles, not really paying attention to the brand or smell. I can say the bottle of very cute and so far hasn't leaked. The smell isn't absolutely amazing, but is still pretty nice and I'll definitely wear it. Shipped quickly, and you definitely can't beat the price!

Words cannot express how much I love this perfume. I was introduced to it by a friend who said she got it as a Christmas gift last year. The scent is great! Can't keep my daughter away from it. I plan to purchase another one sometime soon.
